statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41257 (GHSA-4jm8-m363-4539, https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-4jm8-m363-4539): in jq 1.8.1 and earlier the bytecode VM's data stack tracks its size in a signed int, so when the stack grows past about 1 GiB through deeply nested generator forks the doubling arithmetic overflows and the wrapped size reaches realloc and memmove. It is fixed by https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/01b3cded76daacbfddb7f8763700b0803bcb5c6f, first released in jq 1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2). Checked every jq package in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository for x86_64 and aarch64: 1.8.1-r0 is upstream jq 1.8.1 with Alpine's 3.23 patches, 1.8.1_git20260429-r1 is the same plus upstream commit e47e56d (the CVE-2026-32316 fix), and 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 and 1.8.2_git20261021-r2 are upstream jq 1.8.2, as the version string in /usr/bin/jq and libjq confirms. Every build before 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 is jq 1.8.1 without this fix, and every build from 1.8.2_git20260622-r1 on is jq 1.8.2, which contains it.

CVE-2026-41257 (GHSA-4jm8-m363-4539, https://github.com/jqlang/jq/security/advisories/GHSA-4jm8-m363-4539): in jq 1.8.1 and earlier the bytecode VM's data stack tracks its size in a signed int, so when the stack grows past about 1 GiB through deeply nested generator forks the doubling arithmetic overflows and the wrapped size reaches realloc and memmove. It is fixed by https://github.com/jqlang/jq/commit/01b3cded76daacbfddb7f8763700b0803bcb5c6f, first released in jq 1.8.2 (https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/tag/jq-1.8.2). Checked every jq build in the DHI Debian 13 repository for amd64 and arm64, using the changelog each package ships and its libjq: rebuilds of Debian 1.7.1-6+deb13u1 and 1.7.1-6+deb13u2, a 1.8.1-5 build (arm64 only) whose changelog is an unreleased Debian 1.8.1-5 snapshot from January 2026 with no 2026 security fixes, and a rebuild of Debian 1.8.2-1, which is upstream jq 1.8.2. Debian fixed it in trixie only in 1.7.1-6+deb13u3 (DSA-6416-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-41257), which has no DHI rebuild: the published 1.7.1 rebuilds are based on 1.7.1-6+deb13u1 and 1.7.1-6+deb13u2, whose changelogs do not list it, and the 1.8.1-5 build predates the fix, so every build before the rebuild of 1.8.2-1 is affected.
